iti78:1.1: vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttamarahatā’ti me sutaṃ:
iti78:2.1: “dhātuso bhikkhave sattā sattehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti.
iti78:2.2: hīnādhimuttikā sattā hīnādhimuttikehi sattehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti.
iti78:2.3: kalyāṇādhimuttikā sattā kalyāṇādhimuttikehi sattehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti.
iti78:3.1: atītampi bhikkhave addhānaṃ dhātuso sattā sattehi saddhiṃ saṃsandiṃsu, samiṃsu.
iti78:3.2: hīnādhimuttikā sattā hīnādhimuttikehi sattehi saddhiṃ saṃsandiṃsu samiṃsu
iti78:3.3: kalyāṇādhimuttikā sattā kalyāṇādhimuttikehi sattehi saddhiṃ saṃsandiṃsu samiṃsu.
iti78:4.1: anāgatampi bhikkhave addhānaṃ dhātuso sattā sattehi saddhiṃ saṃsandissanti samessanti.
iti78:4.2: hīnādhimuttikā sattā hīnādhimuttikehi sattehi saddhiṃ saṃsandissanti samissanti.
iti78:4.3: kalyāṇādhimuttikā sattā kalyāṇādhimuttikehi sattehi saddhiṃ saṃsandissanti samissanti.
iti78:5.1: etarahi’pi bhikkhave paccuppanaṃ addhānaṃ dhātuso’va sattā sattehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti, samenti.
iti78:5.2: hīnādhimuttikā sattā hīnādhimuttikehi sattehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti,
iti78:5.3: kalyāṇādhimuttikā sattā kalyāṇādhimuttikehi sattehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti, samentī’ti.
iti78:9.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā. iti me sutanti.
